purpose: OPERATOR REFERENCE ONLY. Per the kit's anti-pattern lock, nothing in this file may seed design_reference.json or tokens.css. The owl template is the sole source of design and structure.
strengths: Deep, genuinely local SEO copy — soil conditions, freeze-thaw, named towns and landmarks. Most of it is usable verbatim as source material.
Broad service taxonomy already built out: build, renovation, repair, cleaning, plus dozens of sub-service pages.
Ten service-area landing pages already exist, so the local intent is mapped.
Real project photography — 28 finished-pool images on /recent-projects.
weaknesses: Conflicting company history on the same site: /about-us says 'Since 1982' and 'OVER 40 YEARS OF EXPERIENCE', while the homepage and every 2025 service page say 'Since 2007' and 'over a decade'. The OG description says 'more than 30 years'. Three different answers.
No testimonials or reviews anywhere on the site despite a 5.0 Google rating.
Third-party accessibility-toolbar plugin injected at the top of the DOM rather than real semantic accessibility.
Contact form is a demo-labelled plugin form ('Contact Form Demo (#1)') gated behind reCAPTCHA that reports 'Recaptcha requires verification' — likely a broken or friction-heavy lead path.
Elementor page weight: heavy embedded Google Maps tiles and unoptimised full-size JPEGs.
Duplicated boilerplate hero/contact block repeated near-identically across service pages.
content_reusable: Service long-copy for build / repair / cleaning / renovation
Service-area town list and local context sentences
